# 24. The report cache never grows past 50 MB

Date: 2026-10-22

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Loading a report on the kiosk is too slow (ADR 0022 requires under three seconds). Two speed-ups were weighed: an in-memory LRU cache, and an index on the existing SQLite cache file. The kiosk has only 1 GB of RAM. ADR 0008 already says the report cache is a SQLite file under data/ and that report data is never cached only in process memory.

## Decision

**Words:** 「FYI the kiosk has only 1 GB of RAM. The report cache must never grow past 50 MB.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-22

**Options considered:**
- add an index to the existing SQLite cache file (chosen; consistent with ADR 0008 and keeps memory use small)
- keep recently opened reports in an in-memory LRU cache — rejected: ADR 0008 forbids memory-only report caching, and the kiosk has 1 GB of RAM

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

The report cache must never grow past 50 MB. Any change to the report cache, in memory or on disk, must stay within that limit.

## Consequences

The speed-up is an index on the SQLite cache (not yet built). The cache needs a size bound of 50 MB, enforced by eviction. Raising the limit or caching reports in memory needs a new ruling from Mira.
